svg.title: AIED — AI in Education, Universitatea din București
svg.desc: A native, editable reconstruction of the supplied logo. A navy A frames a hand-drawn domed university building, crossed by a gold orbit and four-point star. All four lines of lettering are live SVG text. Architectural features are grouped and reuse window, column and ornament components. No raster images or automatically traced contours are included.

g.title: Domed university building — editable architectural components
